Remediation: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent previously healthy production release. Rollout confirmed as rolled_out. args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed and unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Determined v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release and rolled back all regions to it — the rollout completed successfully (`rolled_out` status, verified).
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) describing the failure and the rollback actions; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommended follow-up: investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before attempting another deploy (note that redeploying v2.3.1 would require change-manager approval since it has never been healthy in production).
